_readme: Date types (Sam's Date / spend time menu, in this order). Add a new key to add a date. Chat is a date too (special: chat); there is no separate Gift action (shopping is the gift date).

label, cost (gold), energy (Sam's energy it takes), trust / mood (base gains), like (which personality like it counts as: walk, dinner, theater, gift, private, chat, train; or an array: liked if any is liked, disliked only if all are), restores (her energy +), greedyMood (extra mood for Greedy ladies).
intro + one of lines make the result text ({name} = her name). past: a different version when Sam's backstory matches (cost, trustMult, intro, lines).
image: the date's image scene (comp, setting, snip). It's available as date_<key> in the image menu. A date without image (chat) has no scene.

image may also carry undress ('partial' or 'under': she is shown at most that undressed, within her comfort) and bath (true: a bathing scene; bath-compatible outfits, otherwise towel/undergarments/undressed). image may also carry away: true (an away bath/towel scene keeps its own setting instead of the house bathhouse) and swim: true (a swimming scene: if she owns a bath-compatible outfit, e.g. a swimsuit, she wears it while her dress level would be dressed or partial; it is not a bath scene).

What a date raises (all optional): stats {beauty|charm|charisma|refinement|wits|stamina|strength|agility: n} (her stat XP, 1000 scale like training), skills {service|dance|bar|combat|manage: n} (her skill growth), sam {charm|business|strength|technique: n} (Sam's stats; default {charm:1}), pop (her popularity +n), lust (her lust +n, x her lustBuild), lewd + lewdCap (her lewdness +n with diminishing returns up to lewdCap, see balance.json lewd; more if she loves the date, less if not), gift: true (counts as a gift for her traits), trinket (0-1 chance Sam buys her a little something on the way: mood +5, counts as a gift).
needsUp: an upgrade id the house must own for the date to appear (e.g. bath). needsIntim: the least intimacy stage she must have reached with Sam (w.intim) for it to be listed.

special: 'chat' = the row runs the chat (trust, mood and energy here; random spread x0.6-1.4, Romantic/Shy bonuses, topics from events.json). special: 'nightin' = after the date, if she is comfortable with anything private, Sam can always go inside (no extra action); otherwise just a cosy evening.

spicy: [ {label, acts:[service ids], lewd (her least lewdness), gain, cap (lewdUp), risk (0-1 chance of being caught), lead (opening text, {name}), nude:true (no act: skinny dipping / figure study; needs her to be comfortable nude), image:{comp, setting, replace} (the variant's own staging: setting is optional and falls back to the date's; for acts comp is added to the service pose, or replaces it with replace:true; nude variants use comp+setting as their own scene and keep the date image's undress/bath/away/swim flags)} ]. Offered as 🔥 buttons after a good date (max 2). Costs Sam 12 energy, no action. With acts: a normal private-time scene (only services she's done with Sam: canSam) with that lead; the act is her favorite if listed, else the highest-th one she says yes to, else the first she's comfortable with.

home: true = the date happens at the house (rooftop, a room, the bathhouse). After a date with 🔥 options Sam picks a daring variant or calls it there (_after.away / _after.home: label of that button, home = text when the evening ends there, invite = text when she asks Sam in; {name}). Either way, if the evening sparks, a second screen offers private time or goodnight.
spicy lead may be a list of variants (one is picked at random). _after invite/home may be lists too.

away.label: 🏠 Head home
home: You walk {name} back. At her door she squeezes your hand, says goodnight, and slips inside.
They take the long way back, talking about nothing. At her door, {name} smiles and says goodnight.
They walk back arm in arm, trading the day's best moments. At her door {name} kisses your cheek, says "Tonight was lovely," and closes the door with a smile.
The streets are quiet, the lanterns burn low, and {name} hums as they walk. At her door she squeezes your hand twice, and goes in.
You see {name} to her door, and she lingers on the step, content. "Same time next week?" she says, laughing, before slipping inside.
invite: On the way back, {name} slips her hand into yours and doesn't let go. At her door, she hesitates. "...Do you want to come in?"
The walk back stretches a little longer than it needs to. At her door {name} fiddles with the latch, looks up at you, and says quietly, "Come inside. Please."
{name} stops at her door, key in hand, and does not turn it. "I don't want tonight to be over yet," she says, and holds the door open.
They reach her door and neither says goodnight. {name} tugs your sleeve, flushed and smiling. "Stay for a bit?"

home.label: 🕯 Leave it there
home: They tidy up together. {name} yawns, says goodnight, and pads off to her room.
{name} stretches, thanks you for the evening, and heads up to bed.
The house is hushed. {name} gathers the cups, yawns, squeezes your arm, and wanders off to her room.
They put out the lamps together. {name} leans against your shoulder for a moment, whispers goodnight, and pads up the stairs.
{name} stretches by the fire's last embers, thanks you for the evening, and heads off to bed with a sleepy smile.
invite: The house has gone quiet. {name} lingers at the foot of the stairs, then looks back at you. "...Walk me up?"
Upstairs, the corridor is dim and the house is silent. {name} stops at her door and turns back. "...Would you like to come in?"
{name} puts out the last lamp and stays beside you in the dark. "It's late," she says, "and I'm not tired. Stay?"
The embers are low, and {name} has not moved away from you in an hour. "My room is warmer," she says, almost shy about it.

walk.label: Walk through the market
walk.intro: You and {name} drift into the market as the lanterns come on, past stalls of copper pans, bundled herbs and sizzling skewers. The air smells of woodsmoke and cinnamon, and {name} sets the pace, stopping wherever something shiny catches her eye.
lines: She haggles a merchant down to half price just to show off.
They split a skewer of something that is definitely not chicken.
She drags you to every single fabric stall.

A fruit-seller presses a pear into her hand, and she bites into it right there, juice running down her wrist, before you can pay. The market is full of chatter, smoke from the grill-stalls, and the bright flap of awnings.
They stop to listen to a street fiddler. {name} hums along under her breath, and you realize you've been watching her instead of the music.
A gust of wind blows the whole stall of paper lanterns sideways, and {name} catches a runaway one in midair with a triumphant grin. The merchant gives it to her for free.

image.comp: strolling arm in arm through a busy market, laughing
image.setting: colorful fantasy market street with stalls and lanterns

spicy.label: A quiet back alley
lead: The market thins out, and {name} steers you into a narrow alley where the lanterns don't reach.

The crowd has gone loud and easy behind them. {name} catches you by the cloak and tows you into a gap between two stacks of crates, where the lantern glow barely reaches. "Two minutes," she says, which is not what she means.
Past a rope of drying laundry the market sounds fade to a murmur. {name} backs you into the cool brick, grinning at your startled face, and listens for footsteps that do not come.

image.comp: pressed against a brick wall in a dim narrow alley, glancing toward the street
image.setting: narrow back alley behind a fantasy market at dusk, lantern glow at the far end, crates and hanging laundry

spicy.label: The empty stall
lead: The merchant has gone home and left his stall under a drawn tarp. {name} lifts the flap, looks both ways, and tugs you inside by your hoodie strings.
A cloth merchant is arguing with a customer two stalls over, and the tarp of the empty one is invitingly loose. {name} hooks a finger in your belt and leads you in among the bolts of silk.
Past the fishmonger's, the stalls turn silent and shuttered. {name} finds one with the tarp tied loose, ducks beneath it, and holds the flap open for you with a look you understand completely.

image.comp: behind the drawn canvas of a closed market stall among stacked crates, a lantern swinging outside
image.setting: closed market stall at night, canvas flaps, crates of cloth, lantern light slipping through the gaps

stargazing.label: Stargazing on the rooftop
stargazing.intro: After dark you spread a blanket over the rooftop slates and bring up a flask of something warm. The two moons hang low and bright above the chimneys, the city hums far below, and {name} lies back to find constellations that probably do not exist.
lines: She traces the constellations and makes up her own names for them.
She tucks herself against your side when the night wind picks up.
They stay far longer than they meant to, talking quietly until the lanterns below go out.
The night air smells of chimney smoke and river water, and the two moons wear thin silver halos. {name} lies back with her hands behind her head, and you lie beside her, trying not to talk too much.
A shooting star scratches across the sky, and she gasps and grabs your sleeve. "Quick," she says, "make a wish, and don't tell me." Neither of them speaks for a while.
The city is quiet below them, the last windows going dark one by one. {name} whispers a story about the stars that is almost certainly invented, and you believe every word.

image.comp: lying together on a blanket, gazing at the night sky, her head on his shoulder
image.setting: rooftop at night under a sky full of stars and two moons, soft lantern glow

spicy.label: Under the blanket
lead: The wind picks up, and {name} pulls the blanket over both of them. Under it, her hand finds yours, and the stars stop being the point.
The wind has teeth tonight, and {name} burrows beneath the blanket and drags you in after her. Warm under the wool, she laces her fingers through yours and forgets the constellations entirely.
"Cold," {name} announces, tucking her feet against yours. The blanket becomes a tent, the tent becomes a secret, and the two moons wander on overhead without anyone watching.

image.comp: tangled together under a wool blanket on the rooftop, only their heads and shoulders showing, flushed and smiling

spicy.label: Wish on a falling star
lead: A bright streak splits the sky, and {name} gasps. "Make a wish," she says, and you wish aloud, with no sense of shame whatsoever. She laughs, rolls toward you, and grants it.
The meteors come in a soft, slow shower, and {name} counts them out loud until she loses track. You turn your head and catch her looking at you instead, and the sky is forgotten.
"That one was mine," says {name}, pointing at a falling spark. "Want to know what I wished for?" She does not wait for your answer, and the blanket does the rest.

image.comp: lying together on the rooftop blanket, a streak of light overhead, faces tipped up and close, flushed

picnic.label: Picnic by the river
picnic.intro: You find a patch of soft grass under a willow, with the river sliding by green and slow. The basket holds bread, cheese and too many pickles, and {name} settles onto the blanket with the golden afternoon on her face.
lines: She falls asleep on your shoulder.
They watch the two moons come up early.
A duck steals a sandwich. She laughs until she cries.
The grass is warm, the river chuckles over its stones, and {name} lays out cheese, bread, and a suspiciously large number of pastries. She hands you the biggest one with great ceremony.
Dragonflies zigzag over the water while she weaves a crown out of clover and puts it on your head. You wear it with dignity until a passing boatman salutes you.
A light breeze lifts the corner of the blanket, and {name} holds it down with her foot while reaching for the wine. They talk about nothing and everything until the shadows grow long.

image.comp: sitting together on a picnic blanket, sharing food, relaxed
image.setting: grassy riverbank under a willow tree, golden afternoon light

spicy.label: Behind the willow
lead: The willow hangs low enough to make a room of the riverbank. {name} looks at you, looks at the branches, and lets the picnic basket go unattended.
The branches sway shut like a curtain, and the river chatter sounds far away. {name} nudges the basket aside, kisses a crumb off your lip, and takes her time with the rest.
Under the willow it is green and still and dappled, a room made of leaves. {name} lies back on the blanket and looks at you with an expression the pickles never inspired.

image.comp: hidden under the drooping willow branches, the picnic blanket rumpled
image.setting: inside the curtain of a willow tree by the river, dappled green light

spicy.label: Honey on her fingers
lead: The honey jar tips and {name} licks a golden streak from her wrist with slow satisfaction. She looks at you, at the sticky jar, and smiles in a way that is nothing like innocent.
The sun is warm and the river lulls everything to a hush. {name} feeds you the last bite of honeycake, her fingertips lingering on your lips, and the basket stays forgotten.
Down where the reeds crowd the bank, no one can see the blanket. {name} dips a finger in the honey, draws a lazy line along your jaw, and leans in to follow it.

image.comp: on the picnic blanket in a hollow of tall grass, honey jar tipped over beside them
image.setting: sheltered riverbank hollow among tall grass and reeds, warm afternoon sun

festival.label: Street fair and games
festival.intro: The street fair has taken over the whole square, all bunting, brass music and shouting game barkers. Lantern light spills over ring-toss stalls and sugar-stick sellers, and {name} is already eyeing the biggest prize on the shelf.
lines: She wins a stuffed dragon at the ring toss and refuses to let you carry it.
They share candied nuts and gossip about every passerby.
She drags you into the dance circle, and you are terrible. She loves it.
A brass band is playing slightly out of tune, and nobody cares. {name} grabs your hand and tows you through the crowd toward the smell of fried dough and honey.

At the archery stall, she hits the target dead center on her first try, then looks at you, daring you to match it. Your arrow lands in a hay bale ten feet to the left. She laughs until she has to sit down.
Paper lanterns bob overhead, and the evening glows gold. {name} gets a ribbon braided into her hair by a stall girl and turns around, asking you what you think. You're speechless for a moment.

image.comp: laughing together at a game stall, holding a prize and sweets
image.setting: lively fantasy street fair at dusk with bunting, lanterns and game stalls

spicy.label: Behind the game stalls
lead: The music is loud enough to cover anything. {name} tugs you between two stalls, into a gap barely wide enough for the two of them.

A drum roll and a roar of laughter swallow the noise of the square, and {name} chooses that moment to pull you behind the canvas of the nearest stall. "Nobody is watching," she says, and decides she believes it.
Behind the prize tent it smells of canvas and spilled cider, and the fair's colors flicker over the ropes. {name} presses a finger to your lips, laughing, and pulls you closer.

image.comp: squeezed into a narrow gap between two game stalls, bunting overhead
image.setting: cramped gap behind fair stalls at night, canvas walls, lantern light and crowd noise beyond

spicy.label: At the top of the wheel
lead: The wheel creaks to a stop at the very top, and the operator below shouts that he is going to take a break. {name} looks at the whole glittering fair beneath them, then at you, and smiles.
The gondola sways with every gust, the whole fair a spill of lantern light below. {name} grabs your arm to steady herself and does not let go.
Up here the music is thin and far, and no one in the square will look up. {name} slides along the bench until their knees touch and kisses you like the wheel might never move again.

image.comp: in a small swaying gondola at the top of a hand-turned fair wheel, the lantern-lit fair spread below
image.setting: wooden gondola at the apex of a hand-cranked fair wheel at night, bunting and lanterns far below

library.label: An afternoon at the Archive
library.intro: The city archive is hushed and golden, thick with dust, old ink and the creak of rolling ladders. Sunlight falls in slanted bars across the scroll stacks, and {name} wanders the shelves with the quiet delight of someone let loose in a treasure vault.
lines: She reads a passage aloud in a theatrical voice until the clerk shushes them both.
They argue over a faded map for an hour, and she turns out to be right.
She finds a shelf of bad romance novels and reads the worst bits to you in a solemn tone.

Dust motes drift through the slanted afternoon light, and the only sound is the scratch of a clerk's pen far away. {name} runs a finger along the spines of the old books and murmurs the titles like a prayer.
They share a single reading desk, shoulder to shoulder, passing a magnifying glass back and forth. Every so often her hair brushes your cheek, and you lose your place.
{name} finds a pressed flower between two pages of an old poetry book and shows it to you, quietly. They wonder together who left it there, and invent three different love stories.

image.comp: reading together at a long table, heads bent over an old book, her finger on the page
image.setting: old city archive with tall shelves, ladders, dusty sunlight and stacks of scrolls

spicy.label: Between the stacks
lead: {name} pulls you into the narrowest aisle, past the ladders, where the clerk can't see. "We have to be very quiet," she whispers.
Between the shelves, the dusty hush makes every breath loud. {name} slides a heavy tome back into place, turns, and finds you exactly where she wants you, close, flushed and trying not to sneeze.
A ladder creaks somewhere far off and the clerk coughs. {name} takes your collar, murmurs "shush" against your ear, and treats the sound as a challenge.

image.comp: pressed against tall bookshelves in a narrow aisle, a fallen book at their feet, trying to stay quiet
image.setting: narrow aisle between towering archive shelves, dusty light, rolling ladders

spicy.label: The restricted room
lead: {name} has talked the clerk out of a key she probably should not own. Behind the iron-banded door, the restricted room is small and dim and entirely theirs, and she locks it behind you with a click.
The restricted reading room smells of wax and leather, and a sign warns against open flames. {name} ignores the sign, and the one candle she lights is the least of the heat.

"Forbidden knowledge," {name} says, closing the door with her foot. She slides a scroll aside and sits on the oak table, drawing you in by the sleeve, and the archive's silence has never felt so loud.

image.comp: in a small candlelit reading room, pushed against a heavy oak table with scrolls scattered, whispering
image.setting: tiny restricted reading room of the archive, heavy oak table, candles, shelves of sealed tomes

hike.label: Hike to the dungeon overlook
hike.intro: The Mountain Road climbs in switchbacks through pine and loose stone, and you are wheezing well before the first bend. At the top the whole valley opens out below, with the dungeon mouth a dark smudge in the far trees, and {name} breathes it in as if it were hers.
lines: At the top they spar with sticks, and she wins more often than you would like to admit.
They share a flask and look down at the dungeon mouth far below, small as a keyhole.
On the way down, her legs give out first, and she blames the boots.
The air gets thinner and cooler the higher they climb, and a hawk circles lazily overhead. {name} pauses at a switchback, hands on her knees, laughing at how winded they both are.
Wildflowers cling to the rocks along the trail, and {name} picks one and tucks it behind your ear without breaking stride. You don't take it out for the rest of the climb.

At the overlook, the whole valley spreads out below them in green and gold, the distant river shining like a ribbon. {name} stands at the edge with her hair whipping in the wind and looks, for a moment, impossibly free.

image.comp: resting side by side on a rocky ledge after a hike, holding wooden sticks, grinning and out of breath
image.setting: mountain overlook above a distant dungeon entrance, pine trees, clear sky

spicy.label: A clearing off the trail
lead: {name} leaves the path without explaining, and you follow. The clearing is quiet and sunny, and a long way from anyone.
Halfway down the ridge {name} stops at a sunlit gap in the pines and spreads your cloak across the moss without a word. Birdsong, warm resin and no one for a mile, and she is in no hurry at all.
The trail bends, and so does {name}, off it and into a hollow of wildflowers that hums with bees. She turns back to you with sun in her hair, and the climb stops mattering.

image.comp: on a cloak spread over the grass in a sunny clearing
image.setting: sunlit forest clearing off a mountain trail, pines and wildflowers

spicy.label: The hunter's cabin
lead: The cabin is half-fallen, with herbs still hanging from the rafters and a bunk against the wall. {name} brushes the dust off the blanket and sits down, patting the space beside her.
A rainstorm pushes them into the old hunter's hut, and the roof holds, mostly. {name} wrings out her braid, shakes out the blanket, and takes a long look at you while the rain drums on.
Nobody has used the cabin in years, but the bunk is dry and the door latches. {name} wedges it shut with a boot, turns to you, and her breath is still quick from the climb.

image.comp: on a rough bunk with a folded blanket in a dusty hunter's cabin, afternoon light through the slats
image.setting: abandoned hunter's cabin high on the mountain, dusty bunk, hanging dried herbs, light through wall slats

wrestle.label: Wrestling match (loser buys dinner)
wrestle.intro: Over dinner you say, out loud and with great confidence, that you could take {name} in a fair fight. She sets down her cup, rolls up her sleeves and shoves the table against the wall, and the rug becomes an arena lit by one warm lamp.
lines: She pins you in under a minute and sits on you until you admit it.
You win one round by accident. She demands a rematch, then three more.
They end up in a breathless, laughing tangle on the floor, and nobody is keeping score anymore.
The furniture is shoved to the walls, the rugs are rolled, and {name} cracks her knuckles with theatrical menace. You, in your shirtsleeves, look like a man regretting several decisions at once.
She hooks your ankle and drops you on the cushions so smoothly that you don't realize you're down until you're looking at the ceiling. "Ow," you say, impressed. "Again?" she asks.
They finally collapse side by side, sweaty and out of breath, laughing at nothing. {name} lets you win the last round, then claims she didn't.

image.comp: wrestling playfully on a padded floor, tangled up and laughing, her pinning him down
image.setting: room with the furniture pushed aside, cushions and a rug on the floor, warm lamplight

spicy.label: She pins you
lead: {name} pins you flat for the last time and doesn't let you up. She doesn't seem to be thinking about the score anymore.
The bout ends the way {name} always meant it to, with you flat on the rug and her weight pinning him there. She is breathing hard, grinning, and not at all in a hurry to call the match.
"Say it," {name} breathes, knee on the cushion beside your ribs. You say something, though not the thing she asked for, and the contest quietly changes rules.

image.comp: on the cushions on the floor, her on top, flushed and breathless from wrestling

spicy.label: Rematch
lead: You, by pure accident, hook a leg and roll {name} onto the cushions. You realize too late that you have won and have no plan for it.
"Best of three," says {name}, who has just lost the second round and is looking up at you, breathless. The third, she decides, will be a different kind of contest.
You finally have her down, her wrists loose and her smile wide. "Go on, then," says {name}, "claim your prize."

image.comp: on the cushions on the floor, him pinning her down for once, both breathless and laughing

massage.label: Trade massages
massage.intro: The room is warm and dim, with towels folded on the bench and a bottle of scented oil gleaming in the candlelight. The deal is fair: you work first, then {name} takes her turn, and neither of them is entirely sure who got the better bargain.
lines: She critiques your technique the whole time, then falls asleep halfway through her turn.
She finds every knot in your shoulders and is smug about each one.
Neither of them talks much. Neither of them needs to.
The room is warm and smells of sandalwood and sweet almond oil. {name} rolls her shoulders and sighs happily as your thumbs find the first stubborn knot. "Oh," she says. "Oh, that's the one."
A single candle flickers, and the sounds of the house fade to a distant murmur. When it's your turn, you yield to her hands with a groan you don't bother to hide.
They talk in low voices between silences, about nothing in particular. The oil is warm, the blankets are soft, and the afternoon slides by unnoticed.

image.comp: giving each other a relaxing oil massage, her lying on her front on a towel, his hands on her shoulders
image.setting: warm candlelit room, towels, oil bottles, soft cushions

spicy.label: Lower...
lead: "You missed a spot," says {name}, and guides your hands over her ass and her thighs, anywhere that isn't her shoulders.
"Mm, lower," {name} murmurs, and your oiled hands travel the way she steers them. The candle gutters, the towel slips, and the lesson is clearly over.
The oil has warmed to the skin, and so has {name}. She turns over slowly, catches your wrist, and decides that shoulders were only the beginning.

image.comp: on the towels, oiled skin glistening in candlelight

spicy.label: Her turn, properly
lead: It is {name}'s turn at last, and she sprawls on the towels with a groan that sounds like surrender. You warm the oil in your palms and she shivers before he has touched her.
{name} hums through every knot you find, softer and lower with each pass of your thumbs. Somewhere along her spine the humming turns into something else.
"Lower," says {name} into the folded towel, then "Slower." You, a man of notes and diligence, take this direction very seriously.

image.comp: face down on the towels while he works oil along her back, candlelight on her skin

dinner.label: Dinner at the Lark & Kettle
dinner.intro: The Lark & Kettle is small and golden, with candles in old bottles, a fiddle somewhere behind the kitchen and a menu chalked on a slate. You and {name} take the corner table, and the bread arrives hot enough to steam in the cool evening air.
lines: She orders for both of them after watching you squint at the menu.
You tell her about ramen. She makes him promise to recreate it someday.
She laughs so hard at one of your stories that wine comes out of her nose. They agree never to speak of it.

The Lark & Kettle is all low beams and candlelight, with a hearth crackling at the far end. {name} orders the house stew and the good bread without even looking at the board, and the waiter gives her an approving nod.
They share a plate of roasted pears with cream, and {name} steals the last bite off your fork. "Strategic," she says, unrepentant.
The innkeeper brings a second bottle they didn't order, claiming it's a gift from the next table. {name} raises her glass in thanks to a startled stranger, and you laugh into your cup.

cook.intro: You cook for {name} in the kitchen after closing.
lines: She has thirds.
She tries to get the recipe out of you and fails.
She says it's the best thing she's eaten in this world.

image.comp: sharing a candlelit dinner, leaning toward each other, smiling
image.setting: small cozy fantasy restaurant, warm candlelight

spicy.label: Under the tablecloth
lead: The tablecloth hangs low and the waiter is busy. {name} keeps a perfectly composed face and a very busy hand in your lap.

The candle is low and the waiter has vanished into the kitchen for the third time. {name} keeps her face a mask of polite interest while her hand wanders beneath the long cloth, and you forget how to hold a spoon.
"Pass the salt," says {name} in a perfectly even voice, one hand fully occupied elsewhere. You pass it with a trembling hand and the faint hope that nobody is looking.

image.comp: seated side by side at a candlelit table, her face perfectly composed while her hand is hidden under the long tablecloth, his face flushed

spicy.label: Dessert upstairs
lead: The pastry is served and {name} suddenly needs the washroom, which, the waiter says, is up the back stairs. She takes your hand and does not go to the washroom.
The stairs behind the kitchen are narrow and dark, and smell of wine and rosemary. {name} stops two steps above you, which puts her at exactly the right height.
"I'll show you where they keep the good dessert," says {name}, and leads you past a barrel and up the creaking back stairs. It turns out to be a very short tour.

image.comp: on a dim back stairwell with crates of wine, close together, the kitchen light below
image.setting: narrow back stairwell of a small restaurant, lantern on a hook, crates of wine, kitchen noise from below

dance.label: Dancing at the Silver Fiddle
dance.intro: The Silver Fiddle is loud and warm and crowded, the floorboards bouncing under a band that does not know the word rest. Lanterns sway overhead, mugs clack on every table, and {name} grabs you by the wrist and hauls you into the middle of it all.
lines: You step on her feet twice before she takes over and leads.
She teaches you a spin and you nearly take out a waiter.
A slow song comes on, and neither of them says anything for its whole length.
The fiddler picks up the tempo, and the whole floor starts to stamp and spin. {name} pulls you into the middle of it with a laugh, her skirt swirling and her cheeks bright.
Sweat, spilled ale, and the thump of boots on boards: the Silver Fiddle at its loudest. {name} shouts something in your ear that you can't hear, then kisses your cheek instead.
They finally stagger out into the cool night air, ears ringing, shoulders bumping. {name} is still humming the last tune, and you suspect you will be too.

image.comp: dancing close together, her leading, laughing
image.setting: lively fantasy dance hall with a fiddle band, lanterns and wooden floor

spicy.label: The coat room
lead: {name} drags you through a curtain into the coat room, where the music comes muffled and the door has no lock.
The coats muffle the fiddle to a distant heartbeat. {name} pulls the curtain across and backs you into a rack of cloaks, laughing against your neck, with no lock on the door and no reason to care.
Past the dancers, past the bar, behind a curtain, the coat room is a cave of wool and lamplight. {name} is out of breath from the reel and not at all done moving.

image.comp: among hanging coats and cloaks in a cramped coat room, a curtain half drawn behind them
image.setting: cramped coat room of a dance hall, rows of cloaks, muffled music, a single lantern

spicy.label: The lamplit courtyard
lead: The reel finishes and {name}, laughing and breathless, steers you out the back door to the cool of the courtyard. Under the strung lanterns she pulls you down onto the bench.
Out in the courtyard the night is quiet and the fiddle is a heartbeat through the wall. {name}'s hair has come loose, her cheeks are flushed, and she is very much not done dancing.
"Need air," says {name}, who does not need air. The courtyard has a bench, a gap in the lanterns and nobody else, and she makes use of all three.

image.comp: on a stone bench in a dim courtyard, strings of lanterns swaying, music faint through the wall
image.setting: quiet back courtyard behind a dance hall, strings of lanterns, stone bench, a rain barrel, music through the wall

theater.label: A night at the theater
theater.intro: The Hollowmere Players are doing a tragedy, and the velvet seats of the old theater are full of people already sniffling. Candles gutter along the stage, a painted storm rolls across the backdrop, and {name} leans in close to whisper commentary on the acting.
lines: She cries through the whole third act and denies it afterward.
You fall asleep in act two. She pokes him awake, grinning.
She whispers commentary the entire time. It is better than the play.
The lanterns dim, the curtain rises, and the audience quiets to a reverent hush. {name} leans forward in her seat, lips slightly parted, entirely lost in the first scene.
A villain stalks onstage in a dramatic cape, and {name} whispers, "I'd have him arrested." You whisper back, "He's the king." "Even worse," she says.
At the final bow, the whole house is on its feet. {name} wipes her eyes and applauds hardest of all, then catches you watching and tries to look stern about it.

image.comp: seated side by side in a theater box, watching the stage, her hand on his arm
image.setting: ornate fantasy theater, red velvet seats, stage lights

spicy.label: In the dark of the box
lead: The lights go down for the second act. {name}'s hand settles on your thigh, and stays there, and then wanders up toward your cock.
The tragedy reaches its great speech, and {name} stops listening to a word of it. Her fingers find your knee in the dark, and the box feels very private indeed.
In the dim of the box the stage glows like a distant fire. {name} leans across you, pretending to look at the tragic duel below, and finds better things to do with her hands.

image.comp: in the dark of a private theater box, the stage glowing far below

spicy.label: Behind the curtain
lead: After the final bow, {name} slips a stagehand a coin and leads you into the wings. The set pieces loom around them, painted mountains and cardboard moons, and she shuts out the world.
Backstage smells of greasepaint and old velvet. {name} runs a hand along a costume rack, picks out a feathered cloak, and winds you into it by the collar.
The tragedy ends in applause. In the wings behind a painted tree, {name} breaks the stage silence with a very un-tragic laugh and pulls you closer.

image.comp: among painted flats and costume racks backstage, the empty stage glimmering past the wings

shopping.label: Shopping (she picks something)
shopping.intro: Old Town's boutiques glow in the afternoon light, brass signs swinging over doors that jingle when they open. {name} sweeps through them with a hunter's eye, trying on hats, sniffing perfumes and holding up silks, while you trail behind as the designated bag-carrier.
lines: She comes out with a ridiculous hat.
She comes out with a silk scarf.
She comes out with a pair of earrings she "absolutely needed."
She comes out with perfume that smells like rain.

A shopkeeper in a bright waistcoat sweeps out of the back with an armful of silks, and {name} holds each one up to the window, turning slowly. Your role is to hold things and nod, and you commit to it.
She tries on a ridiculous feathered cap and strikes a pose that makes the clerk cough into her hand. You buy it on the spot, and are fiercely proud of yourself.
The shops of Old Town glow in the afternoon light, brass signs swinging in the breeze. {name} haggles with grim delight, and you carry the bags and the bruised pride of the shopkeepers.

image.comp: holding up a new purchase and showing it off happily
image.setting: elegant fantasy boutique full of fabrics and jewelry

spicy.label: In the changing room
lead: "Help me with this clasp," says {name}, and pulls you into the changing room with her. The curtain swings shut behind them.
"I think the fitting needs a second opinion," says {name}, and the changing-room curtain closes on your yelp. The mirror gets a better view than the shopkeeper ever will.
Silk slips over a bench and the lamp throws their shadows against the velvet. {name} turns her back to you and asks, very sweetly, for help with a button that does not exist.

image.comp: inside a curtained changing room, her reflection in a tall mirror, new clothes half on
image.setting: small boutique changing room with a velvet curtain, tall mirror and a cushioned bench

spicy.label: The stockroom
lead: "This one comes in blue, I'll just check the back," says {name} to the shopkeeper, and crooks a finger at you. The stockroom door swings shut behind them.
The shopkeeper is busy with a duchess, and {name} knows where the good silks are kept. Among the fabric bolts and hat boxes, she pulls you down into the soft dark.
The stockroom is lit by one swinging lamp, with rolls of velvet stacked to the ceiling. {name} sits on a trunk, hooks a foot behind your knee and draws you in.

image.comp: in a cramped boutique stockroom among rolls of fabric and hat boxes, one hanging lamp swaying
image.setting: cramped boutique stockroom, rolls of fabric, stacked hat boxes, one hanging lamp

springs.label: Day at the hot springs
springs.intro: The springs lie high in the hills, where steam coils off the rocks and the air smells of minerals and pine. Snow dusts the branches, the water is hot enough to make you yelp, and {name} sinks in with a sigh that melts into the mist.
lines: {name} comes back pink-cheeked and completely relaxed.
The steam rises from the rocks in soft white curls, and the water is exactly the right side of too hot. {name} slides in with a long groan and rests her head on the stone rim.
Birdsong and the sound of running water fill the quiet, and the afternoon light filters through the pines. You close your eyes for a moment, and when you open them, {name} is smiling at you.
They pass a small flask of cold tea back and forth, saying very little. Every so often {name} sinks to her chin in the water and blows slow bubbles, utterly content.

image.comp: relaxing together in a steaming outdoor hot spring, flushed and content
image.setting: mountain hot spring among rocks and snow-dusted pines

spicy.label: A private pool
lead: The attendant leaves them a private pool behind the rocks. {name} lets the steam hide her smile and slides closer through the water.

The attendant bows and vanishes with a tray of cups, leaving a shelf of rock and a pool that is theirs alone. {name} lets the water carry her closer, steam beading on her lashes, and does not ask permission.
Behind the boulders the world shrinks to heat and mist. {name} drifts to your side, rests her cheek on your shoulder, and her hand disappears below the surface.

image.comp: half-submerged in the steaming water of a private pool, steam curling around them
image.setting: secluded private hot spring pool behind rocks, steam, snow-dusted pines

spicy.label: A night soak
lead: By evening the other guests have gone, and the lantern burns low on a rock. Snowflakes drift into the steam and vanish, and {name} sinks to her chin with a dreamy smile.
The night is cold, the water is hot, and {name} sees no reason to leave either. She slides through the steam to you, dripping and glowing, and puts her arms around your neck.
A flake of snow lands on {name}'s lashes and she laughs. The spring is quiet, the stars are out, and she pulls you closer to keep the cold away.

image.comp: in the steaming water of the spring at dusk, snow falling softly onto their wet hair
image.setting: outdoor hot spring at dusk, a lantern on the rocks, soft snow falling through the steam

lake.label: Swim at the hidden lake
lake.intro: The path to your lake is half-forgotten, ending at a still, clear pool ringed with reeds and old willows. No one has been here in weeks, the water is glass, and {name} looks at it with open mischief.
lines: She wades in first and splashes you until you follow.
They float on their backs and say nothing for a long while.
She dries off in a sunny patch of grass, completely unbothered by your staring.
The water is clear, cold, and quiet, ringed with reeds and old willows. {name} wades in up to her knees and lets out a startled yelp at the chill, then plunges in.

Sunlight breaks into a thousand pieces on the surface, and a heron stalks the far shore. {name} floats on her back, eyes closed, saying nothing, and you try to remember the last time you felt this peaceful.
They share a towel on the mossy bank afterward, hair dripping, teeth chattering, laughing. A frog sings from the reeds, and {name} sings back at it.

image.comp: swimming and playing in the water together, wet hair, laughing
image.setting: secluded forest lake with clear water, sunlight through the trees

spicy.label: Skinny dipping
lead: {name} looks around the empty shore once, then leaves her clothes on a rock and wades in without them. "Well?" she calls back.
{name} glances over her shoulder at the empty trees, then pulls her shift over her head and leaves it on a stone. "It's only polite to match the lake," she says, and lets the water take her.

There is no one for miles, only reeds and a heron that politely looks away. {name} sheds the last of her clothes and steps in, ripples spreading around her, and tilts her head at you like an invitation.

image.comp: swimming bare in the clear lake, looking back over her shoulder at him, her clothes left on a rock

spicy.label: More than swimming
lead: The water is cool and the grass is warm. {name} stops pretending they came here only to swim.
They flop out of the water onto the sun-warm grass, laughing, shivering, steaming a little. {name} gives up on the towel, and also on the idea that this was only a swim.
The sun has dried the shore to warm gold. {name} stretches out beside you, water still beading on her skin, and kisses you as though the lake was the warm-up.

image.comp: on the warm grass at the water's edge, still wet from the lake

spicy.label: On the old jetty
lead: A crooked jetty runs out over the water, warm planks under the evening sun. {name} lays the towel down, stretches out, and her smile is slow and unhurried.
They climb dripping onto the old pier, and the boards creak under them. {name} wrings out her hair, glances at the empty shore, and decides the towel can stay where it is.
The dock is gray with age and warm as bread. {name} sits on the edge, feet in the water, and pulls you down beside her, close enough that the lake can only gossip with the reeds.

image.comp: on a weathered wooden jetty over the water with a towel spread beneath them, low sun, wet hair

soak.label: Late soak in the bathhouse
soak.intro: The last client has gone, the lanterns burn low, and the bathhouse is yours and {name}'s alone. Steam gathers in the rafters, the tiles are warm underfoot, and the water laps quietly at the edge of a long, tiring day.
lines: She sinks into the water with a long sigh and drifts closer without a word.
You scrub her back. She returns the favor, and takes her time.
They linger until the water cools and the lanterns burn low.
The lanterns cast moving gold across the water, and the steam curls up toward the dark rafters. {name} tips her head back against the rim with a long, quiet exhale.
The sounds of the house are far away, only the drip of water and the faint creak of old timbers. {name} slides closer through the warm water, resting her shoulder against yours.
She hums something slow while she pours water over your shoulders from a wooden pail. It's an old song from somewhere far from here, and you don't ask her to stop.

image.comp: soaking together in a steaming bath, relaxed and flushed, close to each other
image.setting: steamy tiled bathhouse after hours, glowing lanterns, warm water

spicy.label: Wandering hands
lead: The water is warm and the lanterns are low. {name}'s hands stop scrubbing and start wandering, and she doesn't pretend otherwise.
The scrubbing brush goes forgotten at the edge of the tub. {name}'s hands slide from your shoulders downward, slow and sure, toward your cock, and the steam hides nothing that matters.
The water swirls warm around them and the lanterns blur in the steam. {name} stops pretending to wash and begins, deliberately, to explore.

image.comp: close together in the steaming bath, hands under the water

spicy.label: She scrubs your back
lead: "Turn around," says {name}, taking up the soap. Her hands are warm and slow on your back, and the steam makes it very hard to say no.
{name} sits behind you on the rim of the tub and scrubs, dutifully, for about as long as it takes to lose count. After that her arms slide around your chest.
The soap smells like lavender. {name} lathers your shoulders, murmurs that he works too hard, and lets her hands wander a little lower than the scrub brush ever could.

image.comp: in the steaming bath with her behind him, soap suds on his shoulders, arms around him

posing.label: Pose for your sketchbook
posing.intro: You once took an art class, and today you have propped an easel by the window, set out charcoal and dragged in a pile of drapery. {name} arranges herself in the sunlight with a lazy smile, and you find out how little of the class survived.
lines: She holds a pose with great dignity while you scowl at your page.
Your drawing looks nothing like her. She frames it anyway.
She critiques your shading, then shifts the pose to see you blush.

You arrange a drape, a chair, and a bowl of fruit, then step back and squint like a master. {name} settles into the chair with perfect composure, and the afternoon light finds her cheekbone and stays there.
"Hold still," you say, for the fifth time. "I am," {name} says, "you're the one fidgeting." The charcoal scratches busily on, and your tongue pokes out the corner of your mouth when you concentrate.
By the time the light fades, the sketchbook is full of half-finished faces and a few honestly lovely lines. {name} peers over your shoulder, and for once says nothing sarcastic at all.

image.comp: posing gracefully while Sam sketches her, a sketchbook in his hands
image.setting: cozy sunlit room with an easel, charcoal sketches and drapery

spicy.label: Figure study
lead: "A real study needs less drapery," says {name}, and lets it fall. Your pencil stops moving.
"Let me see your line," murmurs {name}, and the drapery pools at her feet. Your charcoal hangs forgotten over the page, and the sunlight on her shoulders is not a subject he can capture.
{name} lets the cloth slide, one fold at a time, until nothing is left but window light. "Is this pose all right?" she asks innocently, watching you forget your own name.

image.comp: posing nude on draped fabric while Sam sketches her, the sketchbook in his hands

spicy.label: The sketch can wait
lead: Your drawing is going badly. {name} takes the pencil out of your hand, puts it on the easel, and the sketch waits.
The drawing is hopeless, and so are you. {name} plucks the charcoal from your smudged fingers, sets it in the easel tray, and settles beside you on the chaise.
"Your perspective is all off," says {name}, and leans in to correct it up close. The sketchbook slides to the floor, and neither of them picks it up.

image.comp: on the draped chaise beside the easel, charcoal sketches scattered on the floor

spicy.label: A closer look
lead: "You can't draw what you can't feel," says {name}, and brings your hand to her shoulder. The sketch is long forgotten by the time the light moves.
Your charcoal has smudged her collarbone, and {name} laughs and lets you leave it. The easel tips and nobody rights it.
{name} stops holding the pose, steps off the dais and settles onto the rug beside you. "Now I want a look at you," she says, and her fingers go to your hoodie.

image.comp: on the rug beside the easel, drapery pushed aside, sketchbook open beside them, warm afternoon light

nightin.label: A quiet night in
nightin.intro: There is a fire in {name}'s room, a jug of mulled wine and a blanket big enough for two. The day is finished, the house creaks quietly around them, and for once nobody has anywhere else to be.
lines: She tucks her feet under herself and steals the whole blanket.
They talk about nothing until the fire burns low.
She falls quiet, then leans her head on your shoulder and stays there.
The fire pops and settles, and the shadows on the ceiling lean and stretch. {name} pours the wine with a practiced tilt and hands you the first cup, curling up beside him with a contented sigh.

Outside, the wind rattles the shutters, and inside, a blanket is shared between two people who were definitely not going to share it. {name} tucks her cold toes against your calf and doesn't apologize.

They read to each other from a battered book of tales, taking turns doing the voices. {name}'s dragon is excellent, and yours is lamentable, and they are both asleep with a smile before the final chapter.

image.comp: sitting together on the floor by a fire under one blanket, glasses of wine, relaxed and close
image.setting: cozy bedroom with a fireplace, soft lamplight, rugs and cushions
